items.title: Quoting Daniel Stenberg
items.summary:
During the time these agents converted 185,000 lines of C code into 340,000 lines of Rust code (I counted), we merged over 300 commits in the actual curl project. We actually improved curl during these a little more than three weeks. A little over 200 bugfixes actually. 200 bugfixes that none of those rust rewrites have. We also fixed a few vulnerabilities. In another month we have done another 200 and maybe fixed a few more vulnerabilities. Will these clones keep up?
— Daniel Stenberg, Actual curl rewrites in Rust

    Tags: daniel-stenberg, curl, rust, security, coding-agents, c, ai, l

items.title: How Business AI Use is Changing
items.summary: Three fresh enterprise AI datasets from Ramp, Databricks and Arcana Research point the same way: price competition has handed buyers real leverage, and the leading companies are using a lot more AI without paying proportionally more for it. Plus: Nvidia's board appears to shut the door on Jensen's return, Commerce finally moves on chip diversion, and OpenAI's embedded safety evaluators fall short of what was promised.
